title: OMIE - Spain and Portugal electricity prices
description: Monitor OMIE day-ahead electricity market prices for Spain and Portugal directly in Home Assistant.
body:
[OMIE](https://www.omie.es/en) is the electricity market operator for the day-ahead and intraday energy markets in Spain and Portugal. The **OMIE** integration retrieves day-ahead market prices from the OMIE APIs and makes them available within Home Assistant.

Having the wholesale electricity prices within Home Assistant enables a range of use cases, such as:

- Calculating electricity bills ahead of time (for those on variable-price tariffs that are linked to the wholesale price)
- Deciding whether to export locally produced energy (for example from solar panels) to the grid

## Sensors

The **OMIE** integration retrieves the results of the [day-ahead market](https://www.omie.es/en/mercado-de-electricidad) for Spain and Portugal daily and exposes them as the following sensors.

- **Portugal spot price**: Current quarter-hour electricity spot price in Portugal, in €/kWh.
- **Spain spot price**: Current quarter-hour electricity spot price in Spain, in €/kWh.

## Data updates

The OMIE integration polling OMIE for new data at the start of each quarter-hour (in Central European Time).

## Removing the integration

This integration follows standard integration removal. No extra steps are required.
